summary.headline: Valentinian Nativity and Solar Significations
summary.text: Editorial discussion of two nativity examples attributed to Vettius Valens, correcting the Diocletian-era date and punctuation for Emperor Valentinian and identifying Spain, Ravenna, and Firmicus’s Ancona comparison. The page then resumes an astrological text describing the Sun’s significations, including kingship, leadership, prudence, divine oracle, and public affairs.
